#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(n + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; ++j) {
            if (j != i) {
                dp[i][j] += dp[i][j - 1];
            }
            if (i != 0) {
                dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j];
            }
            dp[i][j] %= MOD;
        }
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int j = n; j >= 0; --j) {
        for (int i = j - 1; i >= 0; i -= 2) {
            ans += dp[i][j];
            ans %= MOD;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
